intro: Affordable prices, a warm climate and high-quality healthcare. Bangkok is the urban hub, while the islands are for a slower pace of life and winter stays.
climate: Tropical with three seasons: hot, rainy and cool. On the islands it stays +27–32°C all year round.
mentality: The Thai smile as a cultural norm, tolerance towards foreigners, family values and Buddhist tolerance.
language_note: Thai is a tonal language and difficult for Russian speakers. English is found in tourist areas and central Bangkok.
visa_note: Visa-free for 30 days. The LTR (10 years) for incomes of $80,000+, the DTV (5 years) for remote workers, and the Education Visa (1 year) for language schools.
